500._measured: 2026-11-22 on darwin/arm64, Apple M3 Max (14 cores), at GeneratedCodeIsVersion27, n=500 schemas in one generated gen package, s=100 services, GOFLAGS=-p=2. Checked as CPU time (user + system of each command and the children it reaped) over the reference build of the same run (the module ref, built cold with a fresh GOCACHE before the cold build and after the schema edit; the denominator is the mean of the two). Three runs, one at a time, on a machine shared with other builds: 1-minute load averages of 33.80, 84.99 and 154.21 before each. Reference CPU (before, after) 46.48, 30.68 / 30.83, 31.89 / 33.59, 30.32 s. Cold build CPU 243.81, 183.89, 186.67 s, cold_build_x 6.32, 5.86, 5.84 (spread 8%); schema edit + regenerate + rebuild CPU 159.96, 168.26, 158.57 s, schema_edit_rebuild_x 4.15, 5.37, 4.96 (spread 29%: the first run's reference before was slowed by the load, which lowered its ratio; the threshold comes from the largest, so it still gates). Rule: each threshold is 1.3x the largest of three runs, rounded up to 0.1 (or to 1 MB for link memory): cold 6.32 -> 8.3, edit 5.37 -> 7.0, service 4.51 MB -> 5.9, link peak 229.8 MB -> 299. Wall-clock times (239.3, 122.2, 231.6 s cold; 130.5, 133.7, 105.3 s edit) are printed for information only and not checked. The 2026-10-29 calibration allowed 2x (13.0, 10.7, 8.5 MB, 420 MB). Recalibrate from the first Linux CI run (followups, 1.0 release)

500-graphql._measured: 2026-11-22 on darwin/arm64, Apple M3 Max (14 cores), at GeneratedCodeIsVersion27, the -graphql variant: n=500 schemas that also carry velox-graphql's annotations (a root query field, OrderField and WhereOps on name), generated with -plugin velox-graphql into one gen package, s=100 services that each call the root connection function and the next edge's method of five entities, GOFLAGS=-p=2. Checked as CPU-time ratios to the reference build, as in the 500 entry. Three runs, one at a time, at 1-minute load averages of 61.31, 45.85 and 14.72 before each. Reference CPU (before, after) 31.07, 30.59 / 28.79, 28.02 / 28.90, 28.87 s. Cold build CPU 215.58, 203.71, 216.86 s, cold_build_x 6.99, 7.17, 7.51 (spread 7%); schema edit CPU 193.15, 185.16, 192.28 s, schema_edit_rebuild_x 6.27, 6.52, 6.66 (spread 6%). Rule of the 500 entry: 1.3x the largest, rounded up: cold 7.51 -> 9.8, edit 6.66 -> 8.7, service 6.64 MB -> 8.7, link peak 279.8 MB -> 364. Wall-clock times (101.4, 56.3, 95.2 s cold; 79.1, 50.4, 80.8 s edit) are printed for information only and not checked. The 2026-10-29 calibration measured cold_build_x 14.72 and allowed 2x (29.5, 28.5, 16.7 MB, 993 MB). Recalibrate from the first Linux CI run (followups, 1.0 release)
